name: Permanent Residence (Settling / Indefinite Leave to Remain)

requirement_groups.name: 3 years of continuous temporary residence or asylum status

requirements.blocker_text: 3 years of continuous residence in Serbia on the basis of approved temporary residence or granted asylum. Continuous residence tolerates multiple absences totaling up to 10 months, or a single absence of up to 6 months, within the 3 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous temporary residence or hold asylum status, applying no earlier than 60 days before the 3-year mark.

requirement_groups.name: Exempt: minor child of a citizen/PR holder, or of Serbian origin/descent

requirements.blocker_text: A minor child with at least one parent holding Serbian citizenship or permanent residence, a person originating from or of Serbian descent, or a foreign national whose residence is deemed to serve Serbia's interests, may obtain permanent residence without completing the 3-year continuous-residence requirement.

evidence_required.document: Proof of subsistence (employment, savings, or financial guarantee)
Supporting documents for the specific basis (employment contract, kinship certificate, property ownership, etc.)

sources.title: Serbian Ministry of Interior (MUP) -- permanent residence requirements: 3 years continuous residence on temporary-residence or asylum basis, continuity tolerances, application timing, exemptions for minor children of citizens/PR holders, persons of Serbian origin/descent, and cases serving Serbia's interests

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Serbia). MUP's own page did not explicitly state whether permanent residence itself expires/requires renewal or automatically confers work rights -- work_rights and duration_length ('indefinite', non-renewable status card aside) modeled based on the general pattern of 'permanent'/'settled' status across this dataset and corroborated by tier-3 legal-guide sources reviewed during search, not an exact tier-1 quote for those two specific fields; the 3-year residence figure and its exemptions are tier-1 quoted directly. citizenship_after_months (36) reuses rs_naturalisation.json's statutory 3-year domicile figure -- see that file's notes for the practical-vs-statutory timeline discrepancy.
